title: Level 4 (Expert) - B-26
notes:
West leads the ♦10 against 6♠. East wins the ♦A and returns the suit. South's only possible loser is in the trump suit.

South must play to prepare for a possible trump coup against 4 spades to the ♠J in East's hand. Before drawing trump, South should cash the ♣A and play another club, ruffing in hand. To draw trump, South should start by cashing the ♠A or ♠Q on the first round of the suit. On the second round of trump, West discards. North wins the ♠K and another club is ruffed.

South's trump length has been reduced to that of East's. For the trump coup to work, East must have 3 or more hearts. There is no need to cash South's last diamond which would risk East having a doubleton diamond.

South cashes 3 rounds of hearts, overtaking with the ♥A on the third round. North's fourth heart is played. East must follow (it would make no difference if he could ruff) and South discards his good diamond.

At trick 12, South is essentially in a position to finesse against the ♠J despite the fact that North has long been out of spades.
